text:
The response is largely accurate. The term, equipment, fee, 24-month price fix, 4% escalation, 75% early-exit payment, end-of-term options, rollover, and contact all match the source. One minor issue: it says term months will "exceed the colour allowance by about $195/month," but the source gives $195 as the cost of the overage, not the size of the excess. The summary also omits the per-page overage rates, which a manager might want, though they are not essential. On length, my count is roughly 125 to 128 words, slightly over the 120-word limit, which is a clear instruction miss even though the content is tight. Structure is clean and scannable for a busy reader.

Score: 7
